name: generateAppointmentReport
shortDescription: Generates a comprehensive report on appointment activities, including metrics like cancellations and doctor utilization.
description:
Overview

Compiles and generates a detailed report on various appointment activities and metrics for administrative review, based on specified filters.

Intended use

Called by the admin-facing reporting UI when an administrator requests an appointment report. Optional parameters include date ranges, doctor IDs, and appointment statuses.

Logic

  1. Query Appointment entities using ctx.data.query based on provided filters (e.g., date range, doctorId, status).
  2. Aggregate the retrieved data to calculate metrics such as total appointments, confirmed appointments, cancelled appointments, and doctor utilization rates.
  3. Optionally, retrieve associated Patient and Doctor details for richer reporting context.
  4. Format the aggregated data into a structured report (e.g., JSON object).
  5. Return the generated report data.

Entities

  • Appointment
  • Patient
  • Doctor
